name: maestro
description: Maestro 5 — Business-layer framework for web & mobile development on top of official Claude Code plugins. RTL/Arabic-native, opinionated stack (Next.js, Prisma, Clerk, Expo), workflow-enforced quality.

plugins.name: maestro-core
plugins.description: The foundation: project onboarding (detects stack, installs official plugins), memory bank, CLAUDE.md gardener, condense mode, install doctor. Ships the single SessionStart memory-sync hook.

plugins.name: maestro-dev
plugins.description: Development pipeline: sdlc orchestration, plan, implement (phased, resumable), review, TDD, debug, brainstorm. Hosts the executor/checker/architect/devil-advocate agents.

plugins.name: maestro-quality
plugins.description: Workflow-time quality: configurable quality gates (off/standard/high/paranoid) invoked at commit and review — never at runtime. Ships the single PreToolUse bash-guard security hook.

plugins.name: maestro-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile standards: React Native / Expo / Flutter conventions, RTL Arabic i18n, RTL PDF generation, SAR currency handling. The Maestro differentiator.

plugins.name: maestro-web
plugins.description: Web standards: Next.js + Prisma + Clerk + PostgreSQL + Zod stack enforcement, UX standards, design review with RTL awareness — layered on top of the official frontend-design plugin.

plugins.name: maestro-pm
plugins.description: Product management: PRD, user stories, and technical specs — FR/EN/AR templates.

plugins.name: maestro-vcs
plugins.description: Delivery: conventional commits with secret detection and quality gates at commit time (the right moment), pull requests, releases. Layered on top of the official commit-commands plugin.
